title: platform-objects: sys_session.revoke_reason's description is the field's published vocabulary and lacks admin_password_reset, the value PR #23440's forced-reset revocation writes
body:
Filing gate ①, class (b): a declared contract that a producer breaks. `reach:` is a named producer: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/forced-reset-revocation.ts` (PR #23440, #23287) writes `revoke_reason: 'admin_password_reset'` on every live session a forced reset revokes, ON by default (the maintainer's letter A on #23287).

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (#18917) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm`, from PR #23440's contract review (`6167875771`, ③ (b), escalated to this seat), checked on `origin/main`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, type and grade are triage's.

## The contract

`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-session.object.ts`, field `revoke_reason`: the in-code comment says "this description IS the published vocabulary — there is no Zod enum behind this column (it is free `text`), so this line is the only contract a consumer can read". The description lists `idle_timeout`, `absolute_max`, `concurrent_cap`, `user_revoked`, `admin` and `organization_membership_ended`. It does not list `admin_password_reset`.

`Seam: platform-objects:sys_session.revoke_reason description → runtime:plugin-auth forced-reset-revocation.ts (FORCED_RESET_REVOKE_REASON) | consumer: none named`

## What done looks like

The description names `admin_password_reset` beside the other causes (an administrator's forced password reset revoked the session), and the four translation bundles regenerate (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`). This lands with or after PR #23440. The value does not exist on `main` until that PR lands.

**Reader who acts:** triage routes it. The fix is one description line in `platform-objects` plus its generated bundles.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `sys_session revoke_reason vocabulary description admin_password_reset forced reset` → 1 hit: #7732 (closed), the interactive revoke path tombstoning rather than deleting — a different defect on the same field. #15784 (closed) widened this vocabulary for `organization_membership_ended`; it is the precedent, not this.

Dedupe words: revoke_reason vocabulary admin_password_reset; sys_session revoke reason description forced reset; published vocabulary free text column.
